evidence.detail: The class emits multiple diagnostics prefixed exactly with "[Model Checker]", including scan start, missing-directory, per-definition match and completion messages.
rs/u accepts a directory path, enumerates files, strips .dat/.gz suffixes, parses numeric filenames as model ids and then scans those ids for references.
The checker walks item definitions and tests modelID plus male/female equipment model fields, NPC model arrays, object model arrays, and GFX model ids, recording every matched model id.
After scanning, it prints the total number of used model ids and the resulting id set, matching the class's explicit Model Checker diagnostics.

proposals.note: ModelChecker is directly supported by the surviving [Model Checker] diagnostics and exact cross-definition model-reference scan; it does not claim more than that explicit v308 role.
